Some righteous people used to say: "God has given me such and such, and I prayed last night such and such, and I remembered God such and such." It was said to him: "Someone like you should not say this." He said: "God the Exalted says: ﴿And as for the favor of your Lord, proclaim it﴾, and you say: do not proclaim it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Speaking of blessings is gratitude." From it is the saying of the Prophet (ﷺ): "Whoever I have bestowed a favor upon and he mentions it has thanked it, and whoever conceals it has denied it."

"Al-yatima" is in the accusative governed by "takhar," and the implied sense is: whatever may be the case, do not oppress the orphan.

The tafsir of Surat [al-Duha] is complete, and praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds.
